specification:
Build a simple Task Manager web application where users can:
- Register and log in with email/password
- Create, view, update, and delete tasks
- Mark tasks as complete/incomplete
- Filter tasks by status (all, active, completed)
- Each task has: title, description, status, due date, priority (low/medium/high)

UI Requirements:
- Clean, responsive interface
- Task list with inline editing
- Quick add task form
- Filter buttons for task status
- Priority color coding (green/yellow/red)

Tech Stack: FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL database, simple HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend
